parameter_provenance.scope: Every numerical simulator input is classified below. Literature citations support only the stated definition or method; they do not estimate Mandi priors or conditional event probabilities.

temperature_c.role: liquid_phase and temperature-change terms in the assumed rain link
temperature_c.evidence: Open-Meteo modeled-grid input; link coefficients are engineering assumptions

relative_humidity_pct.role: humidity term in the assumed rain link
relative_humidity_pct.evidence: Open-Meteo modeled-grid input; link coefficients are engineering assumptions

pressure_hpa.role: six-hour pressure change in the assumed rain link
pressure_hpa.evidence: Open-Meteo grid-surface pressure; not local station pressure

wind_speed_mps.role: wind term in the assumed rain link
wind_speed_mps.evidence: Open-Meteo modeled-grid input; link coefficient is an engineering assumption

pm25_ug_m3.role: Used only by the separate synthetic sensor-pattern classifier
pm25_ug_m3.evidence: No causal rain-link claim is made

pm10_ug_m3.role: Used only by the separate synthetic sensor-pattern classifier
pm10_ug_m3.evidence: No causal rain-link claim is made

temperature_c_delta_1h.role: Cooling proxy in assumed rain link
temperature_c_delta_1h.evidence: Computed from the six-channel history; coefficient is an engineering assumption

pressure_hpa_delta_6h.role: Pressure-fall proxy in assumed rain link
pressure_hpa_delta_6h.evidence: Computed from the six-channel history; coefficient is an engineering assumption

cloudburst_threshold_mm_in_1h.limitation: Uttarakhand definition; this feed has no rainfall gauge or spatial footprint evidence and cannot confirm a Mandi cloudburst

landslide_id_coefficient.limitation: Rainfall-trigger threshold from Nepal; not fitted or validated for Mandi slopes

landslide_id_exponent.limitation: Rainfall-trigger threshold from Nepal; not a slope-failure probability

landslide_duration_hours.limitation: Only 5 and 6 hour windows are simulated; the full published domain is not implemented

rational_method_runoff_equation.limitation: Simplified peak-flow proxy; no Mandi catchment geometry, routing or observed river flow

engineering_assumptions.horizon_hours: Selected six-hour scenario horizon; not a literature-derived hazard lead time
engineering_assumptions.step_hours: Selected 30-minute simulator step; not a claimed sensor measurement cadence
engineering_assumptions.draws: Monte Carlo computation setting; not sample size of observed events
engineering_assumptions.rain_link: All coefficients, intercepts, logistic transforms, rainfall occurrence, log-rate distribution, temporal persistence, rate cap and liquid-phase approximation are engineering assumptions; no cited paper estimates P(rain|these six channels)
engineering_assumptions.latent_ranges: Uniform ranges for soil storage, runoff coefficients, catchment area and concentration time are illustrative engineering assumptions, not Mandi surveys or fitted distributions
engineering_assumptions.families: Drier, central and wetter are unweighted sensitivity cases, not climatological frequencies, posterior intervals or confidence intervals
engineering_assumptions.landslide_wetness_adjustment: The soil-wetness multiplier applied to the transferred intensity-duration line is an engineering assumption
engineering_assumptions.susceptibility_fraction: Assumed simulated fraction of susceptible terrain; not a mapped Mandi slope inventory
engineering_assumptions.Monte_Carlo_seed: Deterministic reproducibility seed derived from the six-channel episode and configuration hash; not a source of evidence

rain_link.pressure_fall.role: six-hour pressure-fall contribution to rainfall-strength logit

rain_link.cooling.role: one-hour cooling contribution to rainfall-strength logit

rain_link.log_rate_strength.role: relationship between assumed strength and log rainfall-rate location

rain_link.liquid_phase_center_c.role: center of simplified temperature-based liquid-phase multiplier

rain_link.liquid_phase_scale_c.role: scale of simplified temperature-based liquid-phase multiplier

latent_ranges.soil_storage_mm.role: unobserved soil storage range in mm

families.*.capacity_m3_s_km2.role: assumed runoff-capacity range; not drainage survey

families.*.susceptible_fraction.role: synthetic fraction of assumed susceptible terrain; no local inventory

landslide_wetness_adjustment.base.role: multiplier base for transferred rainfall threshold

landslide_wetness_adjustment.wetness_coe.role: wetness adjustment for transferred rainfall threshold

context_only_sources.manali_2023_case: Regional event context only; supplies no numeric simulator prior or six-sensor event probability
context_only_sources.wmo_ffg_guide: Supports the need for soil water deficit and catchment context; no local numeric prior is imported

assumptions.rain_link: Every coefficient, distribution, cap, and temporal relationship is an engineering assumption; no paper supplies P(rain|these six channels).
assumptions.families: Unweighted sensitivity cases, not estimated climate frequencies, posterior credible intervals, or known Mandi catchments.
assumptions.latent_ranges: All numeric hydrologic ranges are assumed, not surveyed at Mandi. Uniform distributions are convenience priors.
assumptions.landslide: Nepal rainfall threshold transferred only for sensitivity, restricted to 5 and 6 hours within its reported 5-hour to 30-day domain. The study lacks non-landslide rainfall records and partly estimates subdaily rainfall. Soil multiplier 1.4 - 0.7*wetness and susceptibility fractions are assumptions. Exceedance is a rainfall-trigger proxy, not slope failure.
assumptions.cloudburst: A simulated rolling one-hour total >=100 mm is a rainfall-threshold exceedance, not confirmation of a small-area cloudburst.
assumptions.flood: Simplified Rational Method peak/runoff-capacity exceedance with duration equal to assumed concentration time; not routed river flow or a confirmed flood.
assumptions.particulates: PM channels are validated and preserved in the six-channel contract, but do not drive the rain generator; no supported causal rain link is claimed.

sources.title: Cloudburst events observed over Uttarakhand during monsoon season 2017 and their analysis
sources.supports: 100 mm in one hour cloudburst threshold; upper-air conditions and radar matter. Does not supply six-sensor probabilities.

sources.title: Representative rainfall thresholds for landslides in the Nepal Himalaya
sources.supports: Nepal lower-envelope rainfall threshold I=73.90*D^-0.79, intensity mm/h, duration hours. Not an event probability or Mandi calibration.

sources.title: TxDOT Hydraulic Design Manual: Rational Method
sources.supports: Q depends on runoff coefficient, rainfall intensity over concentration time, and area. Metric conversion 1/3.6 for area in km2.

sources.title: South Asia Flash Flood Guidance System User Guide
sources.supports: Flood guidance requires catchment/drainage characteristics and soil water deficit; these are unobserved latent variables here.

sources.title: Study of Natural Disaster in Manali Valley, Himachal Pradesh, during 09 July 2023
sources.supports: Regional monsoon, western-disturbance and terrain context. Does not provide numeric priors for this simulator.
